tactics: cases a with | zero => simp | succ n => simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (show 1 ≤ b from hb)
rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | ha
obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, b = k + 1 := ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩
have h1 : a ^ 1 ≤ a ^ b ∨ a = 0 := by cases a with | zero => simp | succ n => exact Or.inl (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) hb)
